fix(codeon): teach review agents reject excludes actionable findings (#37)

* fix(codeon): expose Grok review schema

* fix(codeon): bind provider callback catalog

* fix(codeon): match reject-close PR snapshot repository

pull_request_review_snapshots stores owner and repository_name split;
the reject-close lookup compared owner || '/' || repository_name against
the full github.com/owner/repo identity, so existing-PR reviews always
failed with PersistenceUnavailable and crashed the daemon during the
RejectClose input load. Align the predicate with the landing-preflight
join by prefixing github.com/.

* fix(codeon): align Grok runtime with persisted callback catalog

* fix(codeon): persist RejectClose terminal-flow handoff

* fix(codeon): teach review agents reject excludes actionable findings
